limitations: Central 512 x 512 projected-meter crop of HiRISE PSP_001752_1750_RED; exact boxwork target and rover/science-site overlap are unverified.

calibration.method: User-supplied GeoTIFF crop: Mars equirectangular CRS in meters, 0.25 m square pixels; 2048x2048 display conversion without geometric resampling. Distances are projected planar lengths, not terrain-following or safety assessments.
